svg.title: My ninja way
svg.desc: Kritik stands back to back with Naruto beside three things he builds: living interfaces, automation workflows, and enterprise-grade software systems.

g.text: Frontend developer at Wiley by day, anime-web builder by night.
Responsive, pixel-perfect builds in HTML, CSS, JavaScript & React
Scroll-driven scenes, transitions and micro-interactions with GSAP
SQL queries and SAP-integrated business flows that hold up in production
“I don't watch anime. I code anime.”
